principle: Accuracy, provenance, and architectural safety outrank raw entry count.

review-pilot.purpose: Validate editorial workflow, schema and reviewer consistency.

technical-alpha.purpose: Internal and limited integration testing with at least 1,000 verified entries plus the AI-native multilingual architecture gate.

public-beta.purpose: First public dictionary beta with a useful reviewed core vocabulary.

professional-core.purpose: Broad professional dictionary coverage before v1.0 claims.

extended-beta-quality-gate.purpose: Intermediate quality gate for broader domain, morphology, semantic, and translation evaluation before Professional Core.
